scope:
Four-object exploratory controls for runtime, preprocessing and decoding differences.

This supplements the frozen cohort; it is not included in its headline averages.
The four objects are fixed by protocol position, not selected for their results.

sampled_point_to_triangle.method: Area-weighted sampled points to the closest target-mesh triangles; no alignment. F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall within the recorded distance threshold. p95 is the 95th percentile; the maximum is over sampled source points, not the continuous surface.

mesh_runtime_path_difference.distance_units: input model-coordinate units; no alignment or rescaling

intervention_scope: Added during the main run, before these controls were executed. Four objects fixed by protocol positions 0, 4, 8 and 12, not chosen by error. Each intervention changes one pipeline boundary on the released artifact. Results are conditional, nonadditive diagnostics and are excluded from the 96-case cohort.

interventions.default: Same quantized weights, expanded default kernels instead of fused kernels.
interventions.fixed_prepared: Fused quantized pipeline, replacing preprocessing output with the stored original-model prepared pixels; seed reset occurs after preprocessing.
interventions.fixed_latent: Fused quantized octree and Gaussian decoders on the stored original latent with the same sampling seed; no denoising. Anchor identity is not assumed.
